title: Claude Code adapter
description: Managed block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (core rules inline, router just in time), five role subagents with explicit models, attribution off in settings.json.
postInstall: Claude Code: restart sessions to load the CLAUDE.md block and agents (check with /context and /agents). settings.json gets attribution.commit/pr = "" and sessionUrl = false only where you had not set them; nothing else, no permission changes. Agents use the sonnet/opus/haiku aliases; edit the model line in ~/.claude/agents/*.md if your plan lacks one.
